scope.status: both source231 Linux runs fail during Edebug interactive metadata evaluation

frozen.qualification: GNU completes the edebug file; Emaxx aborts after test execution starts without a report. Its fallback load_error label is not evidence of a source-load failure. Earlier printed Edebug activity is not counted as test verdicts.

scope.diagnosis: Both raw traces reach the same host-environment assertion. The independent same-input ordinary probe shows that an interactive bytecode closure wrongly uses its constants vector as a lexical environment. GNU callint.c selects CLOSURE_CONSTANTS only when CLOSURE_CODE is a cons; otherwise Feval receives nil. Source234 implements that rule, but no Linux repair verdict is inferred from this failed-run audit.
